name: style_top_B
prompt: Edit image 1. Keep EVERYTHING exactly as it is: the blue-grey X-ray top-down prison hall, the walls and cells, all HUD text and labels, the camera framing, and the white-cyan thermal operator with the glowing curved shield labelled KNOX. Change ONLY the red glowing blob figure to the right of the operator: replace it with a photorealistic huge muscular death-row prisoner seen from directly above (strict 90-degree top-down view), in natural real colours and real lighting: shaved head, massive shoulders and back, faded orange prison jumpsuit torn at the shoulders, bare scarred forearms, heavy dark iron shackle cuffs on both wrists joined by a short chain, right fist driving forward into the shield. He must have real skin, cloth and metal texture and a soft shadow on the concrete floor, so he is the only realistic full-colour object in the otherwise blue monochrome schematic image. Keep the thin red targeting brackets and the red UNK-01 tag around him. Same scale and position as the original red figure.

name: style_bodycam_1
prompt: A single frame of realistic helmet-mounted body camera footage, first person view, wide-angle lens with barrel distortion, low light, heavy digital noise, slight motion blur, real colours. Inside the death row block of an abandoned island prison: looking through thick rusted steel bars into a large isolation cell lit only by the harsh cone of the wearer's weapon flashlight. Inside, a huge muscular prisoner with a shaved head sits on a steel restraint plate in a torn faded orange jumpsuit, heavy iron shackles on his wrists, head slowly turned to stare straight into the camera with calm, awake eyes. Damp concrete, peeling paint, dust in the light beam. Small white monospace overlay text in the top left corner: 'COLE  CAM 05' and in the top right a red dot and 'REC 02:17:51'. Photorealistic, looks like real found footage, not a film still, no other people visible.

name: style_bodycam_2
prompt: A single frame of realistic helmet-mounted body camera footage, first person view, wide-angle lens with barrel distortion, low light, heavy digital noise, real colours. A long cell block hall of an abandoned island penitentiary, single level, lit only by the wearer's flashlight and one teammate's light. In front of every open cell door on both sides stands one motionless prisoner in a faded grey-orange uniform, arms at their sides, heads slightly bowed, pale grey skin, as if waiting for a roll call that never comes, receding into darkness. In the foreground at the right edge, the back and shoulder of one teammate in dark tactical gear, helmet and sealed gas mask, holding a tomahawk low, seen from behind. Bolted steel mess tables down the middle of the hall. Small white monospace overlay text in the top left corner: 'HOUND  CAM 02' and in the top right a red dot and 'REC 02:16:44'. Photorealistic, looks like real found footage, eerie and quiet.
